epic_goal: Align test suite with intelligent Docker coordinator architecture by removing obsolete tests, adding missing coverage, and validating production readiness with 73 targeted tests achieving 95% coordinator functionality coverage.

blocking_bugs.title: Docker Coordinator Architecture Mismatch
blocking_bugs.description: Coordinator now uses Docker container status tracking instead of Redis queue polling

blocking_bugs.title: Node.js CLI Redis Variable Name Mismatch
blocking_bugs.description: Node.js CLI uses hardcoded REDIS_HOST/PORT instead of CFN_REDIS_HOST/PORT environment variables
blocking_bugs.impact: Agents fail to connect to Redis coordination layer with 'Connection refused at 127.0.0.1:6379'
blocking_bugs.fix_required: Change all REDIS_HOST/PORT references to CFN_REDIS_HOST/CFN_REDIS_PORT

phases.description: Fix Node.js CLI Redis variable name mismatch to unblock all test phases. Update src/cli files to use CFN_REDIS_HOST/CFN_REDIS_PORT instead of REDIS_HOST/PORT.
in_scope: Replace REDIS_HOST with CFN_REDIS_HOST in agent-spawn.ts (3 locations)
Replace REDIS_HOST with CFN_REDIS_HOST in anthropic-client.ts (3 locations)
Replace REDIS_PORT with CFN_REDIS_PORT in both files
Document fix in BUG_6 markdown file
Validate agents can connect to Redis at cfn-redis:6379
entry_criteria: Root cause identified in src/cli files
exit_criteria: All REDIS_HOST references changed to CFN_REDIS_HOST
